name: claret11_spica
label: Claret & Bloemen 2011 linear law for Spica A (25 300 K); also used for Spica B and gamma Cas
sources: [C11] Claret & Bloemen 2011, A&A 529, A75 (VizieR J/A+A/529/A75): linear u(lambda), ATLAS, [M/H] = 0
notes: The same table serves Spica B (20.9 kK, log g 4.2): u differs from A's by ~0.02, below the other uncertainties of this hot pair.
